handbook.what: Going from the summary row into the class itself, where the roster, the teachers, the join link and the class's progress all live.
handbook.where: **My Classes**, anywhere on the class's row.
how: Tap the row for the class you want.
The class page opens on its roster.
handbook.note: The row is a button in its own right, so a keyboard works too. The buttons at the right of the row do their own jobs and do not open the class.
